HOME.TITLE: Dynamic Internationalization
HOME.SUBTITLE: Frameworks for Software Development
HOME.DESCRIPTION: This laboratory practice demonstrates the implementation of dynamic, real-time i18n using Standalone Angular 18/19 components and the new control flow syntax.
HOME.FEATURE_JSON: Asynchronous loading of resources through independent JSON language files.
HOME.FEATURE_STANDALONE: Strict usage of Standalone Components (zero legacy modules).
HOME.FEATURE_FLOW: Structured flow control with the new integrated @if and @for directives.
HOME.FEATURE_DYNAMIC: Reactive real-time language switching without page reloads.
HOME.INFO_ALERT_MESSAGE: The application language has been changed dynamically without reloading the page. The asynchronously loaded JSON dictionaries work properly!
HOME.FOOTER_TEXT: Course: Frameworks for Software Development • Laboratory Practice
